blind_spots_patched: The original monograph evaluated Unbound Medicine only against paid incumbents (UpToDate, ClinicalKey, AMBOSS) and generic chatbots while treating Johns Hopkins Medicine as a moat-anchoring licensed content partner. It completely missed OpenEvidence—a free, peer-reviewed clinical AI platform for verified U.S. clinicians and medical/NP/PA students—which signed a landmark AI medical-education collaboration directly with Johns Hopkins Medicine in October 2026. It also omitted disclosed TNQTech scale (Rs 338.09 Cr FY26 turnover) upon Lumina Datamatics' 100% buyout, TNQTech's October 2026 Editorial Central pre-peer-review integrity launch, and Straive's November 2026 Anthropic and Microsoft Ignite AI alliances.

Chapter 6 flagged FY26's twenty-fold jump in consolidated royalty expense (Rs 0.30 Cr to Rs 6.26 Cr) as unexplained, while Chapters 2 and 5 treated Unbound Medicine's ~18% EBITDA margin as a temporary integration ramp toward 25-30% without identifying its royalty-bearing third-party content licensing structure.

Chapters 1 and 3 flagged permanent-employee attrition spiking to 28.85% and operating-bench turnover, but missed the sub-four-month departure of MPS's Chief People Officer in July 2026 and left the family-ownership link between ADI BPO founder Nishith Arora and Chairman/CEO Rahul Arora unverified.

Chapter 6 noted it had not examined ADI BPO's merger disclosure documents and therefore could not verify liabilities MPS might inherit in the promoter holding-company amalgamation, nor did it cover the August 2026 MPS Interactive shareholders' agreement amendment or new internal-auditor appointment.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Research Solutions runs at 45-48% EBITDA margin on near-flat headcount, with group headcount growth staying below half of revenue growth.
WEAKENED: Education Solutions is an unqualified high-growth engine (+36% H1 FY27), with lower H1 EBITDA growth attributed solely to Unbound Medicine mix without quantifying Q2 segment performance.

CONFIRMED: Research Solutions core ex-AJE continues expanding margin through AI-enabled workflow delivery, while Corporate Learning is rebuilding margin and working back toward low-teens revenue growth.
CONFIRMED: Balance sheet returned to zero bank debt and strong liquidity after repaying the Unbound Medicine term loan in August 2026, with improving collections and client diversification.
